apps.name: R12
apps.subtitle: Training and progress
apps.audience: Members using personal training, programmes and progress features.
apps.description: Plan and record training in the R12 workspace. Open your training plan, review sessions and record progress including weight, measurements and personal bests. Sign in with your R12 account. Access to features depends on your account and current membership.

apps.name: R12 Club
apps.subtitle: Staff gym operations
apps.audience: Authorised staff performing venue checks, member inductions and club operations at Madhouse Rotherham and Carlton.
apps.description: A mobile workspace for authorised Madhouse staff on the gym floor. Complete daily venue and equipment checks, report faults, open member records and record in-person induction outcomes. Choose your organisation and venue. Staff permissions and audit records are enforced by R12.
apps.reviewWalkthrough: R12 Club — staff floor operations walkthrough

apps.name: R12 Coach
apps.subtitle: Coach client workspace
apps.audience: Coaches with an R12 account and Coach workspace access.
apps.description: The R12 Coach workspace for authorised coaches. Review your client relationships, diary, programmes and coaching records. Sign in with your R12 account; client information is limited to relationships and permissions assigned to that coach.
apps.reviewWalkthrough: R12 Coach — coach and client walkthrough

apps.name: Glow Zone
apps.subtitle: Glow Zone balance and visits
apps.audience: Existing Glow Zone Carlton customers with an R12 login.
apps.description: View your Glow Zone Carlton minute balance, expiry information and activity. Read service safety information and see the available minute packages. Account linking, eligibility and any purchase or service access follow the existing Carlton process.
apps.reviewWalkthrough: Glow Zone — customer balance and visit walkthrough
